lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to put several blocks inside a repeat to make longer patterns, like dances and walks around shapes.
A repeat can hold many blocks.
All of them repeat, in order.
Look for the part that repeats — the chunk.
Put the chunk inside the repeat.
Right, down, left, up is a square.
Repeat it to walk round again!
A dance chunk might be: hop, grow, shrink.
Climb the stairs and hop on each step: right, up, hop — 3 times.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
